Connection & setup ＋
  1. Install the ESP32 BLE firmware. Disconnect the actuator battery and leave JP5 open during upload.
  2. Keep the sensor board on CH2 and sensorless board on CH1. Open this HTTPS page in Bluefy.
  3. Tap Connect hub, then choose InflateHub. Set each channel’s times and tap Run cycle.

The valve selects for 0.1 s, the pump runs, then the valve holds for your chosen delay before release. Accepted cycles finish on the ESP32, even if the phone disconnects. Reconnection never restarts a cycle.

Sensor readings are display-only. No pressure or sensor-loss cutoff is enabled. Pump time: 0.05–2 s. Hold time: 0–10 s. Defaults: 1 s each.
